text:
kai (SRE): seeing a burst of 500s from apiserver in ap-northeast-1 ~5m ago. Dashboards show apiserver cpu spike + controller-manager restarts. CC @aj @olivia
aj (oncall): yup alerts came in. apiserver 5xx rate ~12% for ~3m, request queue depth up. Some deployments pacing out.
olivia (infra): correlating with a big GPU node churn from autoscaler — lots of scale-up/scale-down events in the last 10m. Could be watch storms when nodes join/leave.
maria (eng-runtime): attaching short log snippet from apiserver: ```stderr
W0318 12:07:22.451 apiserver request.go:621] apiserver long running request: GET /api/v1/namespaces/default/pods?labelSelector=... took 18s
E0318 12:07:23.122 apiserver handlers.go:214] http2 server error: stream ID 17; INTERNAL_ERROR
E0318 12:07:23.123 controller-manager leader_election.go:129] error renewing lease: etcdserver: request timed out
```
kai (SRE): that etcd timeout stands out. I see increased disk iops wait on controller plane for that region on the metrics. Possibly etcd leader IO contention when many node objects churn (GPU nodes create ~multiple pod resources).
aj (oncall): running quick checks: `kubectl get endpoints --all-namespaces` returns some blank endpoints for kube-scheduler in ap-northeast-1 control plane. Also `kubectl get componentstatuses` times out.
olivia (infra): autoscaler log (excerpt): ```json
{"time":"2026-03-18T12:05:34Z","msg":"scale up","group":"gpu-pool","from":2,"to":8}
{"time":"2026-03-18T12:06:01Z","msg":"scale down","group":"gpu-pool","from":8,"to":4}
{"time":"2026-03-18T12:06:20Z","msg":"scale up","group":"gpu-pool","from":4,"to":9}
```
kai (SRE): autoscaler oscillating fast — that will generate tons of watch events (nodes/pods/taints). Controller-manager has to reconciling endpoints/leases. Etcd getting hammered by small writes.
maria (eng-runtime): quick mitigation suggestion: temporarily pause autoscaler for the gpu pool and reduce watch cache window on apiserver? We can also bump etcd IOPS by switching leader to a bigger instance in the region (manual failover).
aj (oncall): I'm pausing cluster-autoscaler for gpu pools now (running apply to patch the deployment with replicas=0). Will report back in 30s.
deploy-bot: rollback triggered: reverted recent autoscaler config change (deploy/cluster-autoscaler) by @aj — PR#4522.
kai (SRE): after pause, apiserver 5xx dropped to ~1.2% and request latencies recovering. Controller-manager restarts dropped. Etcd leader latency graphs show stabilization.
olivia (infra): still seeing some replica churn from ongoing pod evictions but much lower. I'll open a follow-up to rate-limit autoscaler in presence of control-plane pressure and add backoff.
maria (eng-runtime): action items: 1) autoscaler backoff config/guard rails + rate limit 2) add a small leader promotion step to move etcd leader to nodes with dedicated IO 3) investigate apiserver --watch-cache-size and controller-manager relist intervals 4) run replay test of node churn in staging to tune metrics.
aj (oncall): created incident ticket INC-2026-311 and assigned to olivia + kai. Notes attached: initial mitigation (autoscaler paused), observed root-cause hypothesis (autoscaler oscillation -> watch flood -> etcd IO saturation -> apiserver 5xx and controller-manager leader flaps).
kube-autoscaler-bot: scheduled job create: `stress-test-node-churn` disabled in production; will run in staging.
kai (SRE): thanks everyone. let's keep autoscaler paused until we have a safe rollback+rate-limit. I'll follow up with runbook edits for future similar symptoms.
